# Timeline

```tsx
import { Timeline, TimelineItem } from "@lucasdost/design-system"
```

Lists events in order along a dotted line. Mirrors the Figma Timeline and Timeline Item: date, title, Show Tag, description, Show Actions and Show Action 2.

## Example

From the Storybook story; names like `args` or `label` are the story controls.

```tsx
<Timeline>
  <StoryItem {...args} />
  <StoryItem {...args} />
</Timeline>
```

## Figma notes

Mirrors the Figma Timeline: a list of Timeline Items, up to 560px wide.

## Props

Documented props only; every component also accepts the props of the element or Base UI part it renders (`className`, events, ARIA…).

`TimelineItemProps`:

| Prop | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `date?` | `React.ReactNode` | The date above the title: Label/Small in Text/Secondary. |
| `title?` | `React.ReactNode` | Bold Body/Medium in Text/Primary. |
| `tag?` | `React.ReactNode` | Figma "Show Tag": a Small Accent Soft Tag next to the title. |
| `actions?` | `React.ReactNode` | Figma "Show Actions": buttons below the text, 16px apart (Figma uses a Medium Button Primary and, with "Show Action 2", a Button Ghost). |

## Types

`TimelineItemProps`

## Rules

- Import `Timeline` from `@lucasdost/design-system`. Do not rebuild it with plain HTML and Tailwind classes.
- Style it through its props and variants first. Use `className` only for layout (margin, width, grid placement), never to change its colors, typography or radius.
- Colors come from the S0L tokens; see [color](../foundations/color.md).
